test.name: tautomers_smiles
comment: Without -C, structures are compared as SMILES, so the 2-pyridone and
2-hydroxypyridine tautomers stay distinct. Valid for every build.

test.name: tautomers_inchi
comment: -C compares by InChI, which is only present in builds made with
--config=inchi. The script checks the right behaviour for either kind of
build and prints PASS in both cases. See run_test.sh.
